(a) the theory of planned behaviour is a better predictor of intentions and behavior than the theory of reasoned behavior; (b) perceived behavioral control contributes significantly to the prediction, of intentions; (c) perceived behavioral control is a better predictor than subjective norm; and (d) perceived behavioral control and subjective norm interact in the prediction of intentions.
the theory of planned action is superior to the theory of reasoned acton in predicting intentions and behavior.
the theory of planned behaviour is a useful extension of the theory of reasoned behaviour, and that perceived behavioural control is an important determinant of both intention and behaviour.

the prediction of goal-directed behavior and the role of perceived behavioral control in this prediction.
a model of goal-directed behaviour that includes three determinants of intentions: attitudes, subjective norms, and perceived behavioral control.
the development of a theory that is useful in the analysis and prediction of goal directed behavior.
